title: 18:6 They shall be left together unto the fowls of the mountains. After the Lord has destroyed the wicked (or permitted their destruction), so many human corpses will be scattered on the face of the land that fowls and beasts will feed on the carnage: "And it shall come to pass that the beasts of the forest and the fowls of the air shall devour them up" (D&C 29:20; see also Deut. 28:26; Ps. 79:2; Jer. 7:33; 16:4; Ezek. 32:4).
author: Tina M. Peterson
